title: Siman 398
section: The Matter of the Opposition Against Him

segments.he: גַּםכְּבָר שָׁמַעְנוּ שֶׁמֵּחֲמַת שֶׁמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ בָּאָה מִמַּלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד כַּיָּדוּעַ
segments.en: (7.) Regarding the decrees that were heard in his time — that they wanted to issue decrees against Israel [which, because of our many sins, have already come to pass in our times — may G-d have mercy]. I heard that once he spoke about this and said that it would have been possible to give himself some counsel to engage in this to nullify them — but what can one do when they do not agree with him and oppose him? And he brought proof from the words of our Rabbis of blessed memory in Ta'anis [14b] — that because there was no agreement etc.
